description: What things cost. The single source of price truth — a quote may never invent a price for something not on this list. Volume tiers are columns rather than rows so the whole product line reads at a glance.

columns.name: sku
columns.note: The code that appears on the quote

columns.name: unit
columns.note: What one of these is. Drives the quantity question and how the line reads.

columns.name: list_price
columns.note: Price per unit at tier 1. Never quote below this without a recorded discount.

columns.name: term_months
columns.note: Default contract term this price assumes. A 12-month price quoted for 36 months is a different deal.

columns.name: increment
columns.note: Must be bought in multiples of this

columns.name: floor_price
columns.note: Absolute lowest permitted, whatever the discount. The guard rail that stops a quote going out below cost.

columns.name: max_discount_no_approval
columns.note: Percent. Above this the quote needs sign-off — recorded so the system can say so at quote time rather than after.
